about.heading: ABOUT TRI-STONE
about.text:
Tri-stone construction services takes on the role of main constructor for small to medium size project. Providing a quality construction services includes a new construction, renovation, remodels, repairs, exterior / interior fit-outs, and residential houses.

In particular we enjoy working with our clients and other members of project teams, to provide individual and innovative cost solution to each project brief.

about.heading: Our Principles
about.text: In the pursuit of this goals, we place God above all. And we shall be guided by principles of teamwork, Integrity, discipline, excellence and safety.

about.heading: OUR VISION
about.text: To be a responsible building constructor, delivering growth to our community beyond expectation.
about.second_text: We will strive to implement a long-term relationship with our client, based on quality, timely service, safety and anticipation of their needs. Dedication to providing quality construction services.
